title: Shared document preview uses a bearer link
summary: The preview handler serves a private document when a copied preview token is supplied, even after the document owner revokes the share.
root_cause: Revocation removes the database share row, but the preview handler trusts a signed token without checking the current share state.

title: HTML export escapes dangerous tags
summary: A collaborator can place markup in a document title, but the HTML export escapes the markup before rendering.
root_cause: No injection was demonstrated; the export uses HTML encoding at the sink.

title: Invoice edit race
summary: Two simultaneous invoice updates can overwrite each other's quantity fields.
root_cause: The update route performs an unconditional write without a version check.
